brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

Configurator offers 0 drawer sockets on full base (find_sockets drawer total 0). Max tested is 1 drawer on half-n/half-s variants; 5 drawers requires additional adjacent or stacked cells to create notch/bay positions, which would violate the 'nothing beside/on top' constraint. No build can satisfy both constraints simultaneously.

finish.summary: Single full hex base restored and verified (check_build meshClash clear). Five-drawer requirement impossible under configurator rules: full base has no drawer sockets; achieving multiple drawers requires neighboring cells/levels.
